task_prompt: Prepare a short report on sentiment scores in the collected news articles for the external project-review team. Use the supplied analysis notes; a new calculation is not required. In particular, answer: 2. Calculate the mean and standard deviation of the "compound" sentiment score column.
analysis_notes:
Negative and positive article sentiment scores have Pearson correlation -0.24.

The compound sentiment score has mean 0.141 and sample standard deviation 0.899.

After dropping negative-sentiment observations with absolute z-score above 3, the negative score has mean 0.07 and sample standard deviation 0.04.

For ABC News articles, non-space text length has Pearson correlations -0.35 with positive sentiment and 0.42 with neutral sentiment.
